title: Accept the agent's proposed wording for five small UI notes?
bluf: Five tickets need a wording or accessibility call. 420: make the frame chip count (1 of 3) and the Assessment page count (0 of 2) agree. 438: the rule line on the roadmap names Evidence submitted too, using your existing sentence. 406: approve or reword four phrases on Partner Home. 409 and 432: give the scrolling tables an accessible name. The agent proposes the words; nothing ships to HP before a review. Default if you do not tap: option A, at 10:00 AEDT today (2026-11-10). Tickets: HPSMPOC-420, HPSMPOC-438, HPSMPOC-406, HPSMPOC-409, HPSMPOC-432
